english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, thing, decision, or rule that is stupid or foolish.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 zan1 hai6 ceon2

english.note: Use this about a person judged stupid or slow to understand.

exampleSentences.english: You’re so dense, you can’t even answer such a simple question.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你咁蠢，咁簡單都唔識答。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gam3 ceon2 gam3 gaan2 daan1 dou1 m4 sik1 daap3

english.note: Use this when dull means unintelligent or slow to understand, rather than boring.

exampleSentences.english: Don't think I'm dull; I just haven't thought of it yet.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你唔好當我蠢，我只係未諗到啫。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 dong3 ngo5 ceon2 ngo5 zi2 hai6 mei6 nam2 dou2 ze1

english.note: Use this when “simple” is disparaging and means foolish or dim-witted.

exampleSentences.english: You're really simple—you got even this little thing wrong.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你真係蠢，咁少少嘢都做錯。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 ceon2 gam3 siu2 siu2 je5 dou1 zou6 co3
